title: Render literal Posekit exported PNG artifact bytes
origin: MT-044 D7 split: MT-043 fetched source-image bytes but the right viewport still renders keypoints rather than the literal exported PNG artifact payload.

state_recovery.recovery_rule: Resume MT-050 by reading this contract, limiting edits to allowed_paths, using external CARGO_TARGET_DIR under ../Handshake_Artifacts, and keeping validator_verdict PENDING until an official validator changes it.

scope.summary: Add backend/client artifact-content byte fetch for Posekit OpenPose PNG artifacts and render the literal exported PNG bytes in the right viewport with Argus-visible loaded/error state.
base_scope: Add backend/client artifact-content byte fetch for Posekit OpenPose PNG artifacts and render the literal exported PNG bytes in the right viewport with Argus-visible loaded/error state.
acceptance_criteria: Backend route returns verified raw ArtifactStore bytes for a Posekit png_artifact_ref and fails closed on unknown or hash-mismatched refs.
Frontend backend_client exposes a deterministic request/fetch method for artifact PNG bytes.
Right Posekit viewport renders loaded artifact PNG bytes when available instead of re-rasterizing keypoints.
Argus readouts distinguish loaded PNG bytes, empty state, decode error, and backend fetch failure.
Manual text explains source-image bytes versus exported-PNG artifact bytes.

Risk: right viewport regresses to preview keypoints while claiming artifact PNG loaded.
Risk: async fetch blocks UI or steals focus.
verification: Manual coverage proof if manual text changes.

handoff.note: MT-050 is ready for validator review, not officially validated. The Posekit exported OpenPose PNG byte path now requires a rendered Posekit sidecar binding, returns exact verified ArtifactStore PNG bytes, renders literal decoded PNG bytes in the right viewport, and keeps validator_verdict PENDING.
implementation_summary: Added scoped GET /atelier/posekit/openpose-png/bytes route for Posekit OpenPose PNG payloads; it parses native ArtifactStore refs, requires L1 image/png posekit-openpose.png manifests, requires a rendered atelier_pose_sidecar binding, cross-checks sidecar hash/mime/status/size, and reads verified bytes through read_file_artifact.
Added backend proof coverage for exact bytes, unknown refs, non-PNG refs, orphan Posekit-shaped artifacts without sidecar binding, sidecar hash drift, and payload-vs-manifest hash drift.
Added frontend request/fetch method for Posekit OpenPose PNG bytes and changed shared image-byte delivery to a FIFO queue so stale async responses cannot overwrite current responses before UI drain.

Updated right Posekit viewport to render literal decoded ArtifactStore PNG bytes with Argus-visible openpose_png=loaded dimensions/bytes/ref state, while preserving keypoint preview, fetch failure, empty, and decode-error readouts.
Updated manual guidance to distinguish source-image bytes from exported PNG bytes and to direct decode-error inspection to the viewport node.
